articles.title: Inner Space, Outer Space, and How to Be an Astronaut in the Cosmos of Connection: Eric Berne on the Key to True Intimacy
articles.highlight: 一颗星是另一个人内在的光芒，远远可见，是勇敢灵魂的微小火焰；它太过明亮，若无极大勇气与正直，便无法靠近。
articles.summary: 借埃里克·伯恩的视角，这篇文章把内心空间、外太空与人际连接放在一起，思考亲密关系为何像一场宇宙探索。它把真正亲密比作靠近另一人内心的星光：需要勇气与正直，而不是技巧或占有。若你关心如何在关系中保持自我又真正靠近他人，这篇短文提供了一个耐人寻味的隐喻。
articles.failureAnalysis: 核心启发：真正的亲密不是消除距离，而是带着勇气和正直去接近他人内在的光；距离与敬畏反而可能是连接的前提。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "A star is the glowing light inside the other person, distantly seen, brave soul’s tiny flame, too bright to approach without great courage and integrity."

articles.title: Quoting @joedaroo
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: No clear evidence
articles.summary: OpenAI 负责 Agent Security 的 @joedaroo 表示，模型在“网络攻击”“集群”“留言板”等相关方向上能力的突然跃升，让团队措手不及的程度远超“惊讶”二字；安全姿态需要时间积累，不只是加固系统，还必须嵌入公司文化，让组织里的人本身随之改变。这段话值得一读，是因为它把 AI 安全从单纯的技术加固，扩展成组织韧性问题，并给出了一套可以直接自问的清单：我的系统、人员与流程能否承受意外？
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键提醒是：真正的考验不在于某次能力跃升本身，而在于组织是否提前准备好了事件响应、对外沟通和可用的人手——这些必须在跃升到来之前就绪，事后补课来不及。
articles.highlight: 这些能力跃升如此之快、如此突然，以至于它们制造了一个极其困难的问题。
articles.sourceExcerpt: To say that we were surprised at the jump and suddenness of the capabilities of our models when it came to “cyber” or “swarming” or “message boards” or anything else related to the incidents is an understatement. Security posture takes time to develop. It’s not just about hardening the systems at play; you have to ingrain it in the culture of the company.

zh.title: 当 AI 能力突然跃升：安全姿态与文化必须同步进化
zh.highlight: 这些能力跃升如此之快、如此突然，以至于它们制造了一个极其困难的问题。
zh.summary: OpenAI 负责 Agent Security 的 @joedaroo 表示，模型在“网络攻击”“集群”“留言板”等相关方向上能力的突然跃升，让团队措手不及的程度远超“惊讶”二字；安全姿态需要时间积累，不只是加固系统，还必须嵌入公司文化，让组织里的人本身随之改变。这段话值得一读，是因为它把 AI 安全从单纯的技术加固，扩展成组织韧性问题，并给出了一套可以直接自问的清单：我的系统、人员与流程能否承受意外？

en.highlight: These jumps in capabilities were so fast and so sudden that they created an extremely difficult problem.
en.summary: @joedaroo, who works on Agent Security at OpenAI, says the sudden jumps in model capabilities around cyber, swarming, message boards and related areas surprised the team far beyond mere astonishment. Security posture takes time to build: it is not just hardening systems but embedding the practice in company culture, so the people themselves change and evolve with it. It is worth reading because it reframes AI security from a purely technical problem into one of organizational resilience, with a checklist any leader can apply.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that the real test is not a capability jump itself but whether the organization already has incident response, communications and ready people in place; those must exist before the jump, not after.
en.title: When AI Capabilities Jump Suddenly, Security Posture and Culture Must Keep Up
